pokedexEntries.x: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

pokedexEntries.or: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

pokedexEntries.y: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.

pokedexEntries.as: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.

pokedexEntries.us: It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.

pokedexEntries.um: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon creates an impressive flower garden in its territory. It draws forth the power of the red flowers around its neck.

pokedexEntries.vi: They say that flower gardens created by Florges are constantly showered with a power that can heal both body and spirit.

pokedexEntries.za: They say that flower gardens created by Florges constantly emit a power that can heal both body and spirit.
